import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import triton
import triton.language as tl
@triton.jit
def custom_kernel(
    x_ptr, w_ptr, b_ptr, out_ptr,
    B, C_in, H_in, W_in, C_out, H_out, W_out,
    stride, pad,
    stride_xb, stride_xc, stride_xh, stride_xw,
    stride_wo, stride_wi, stride_wh, stride_ww,
    stride_ob, stride_oc, stride_oh, stride_ow,
    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_OC: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
    C_IN: tl.constexpr,
    KH: tl.constexpr,
    KW: tl.constexpr,
):
    pid_b = tl.program_id(0)
    pid_ocb = tl.program_id(1)
    pid_pix = tl.program_id(2)
    total_pix = H_out * W_out
    offs = pid_pix * BLOCK_SIZE + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
    mask_pix = offs < total_pix
    oh = offs // W_out
    ow = offs % W_out
    oc_offs = pid_ocb * BLOCK_OC + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_OC)
    mask_oc = oc_offs < C_out
    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_SIZE], dtype=tl.float32)
    TOTAL_K = C_IN * KH * KW
    KHW = KH * KW
    for k0 in range(0, TOTAL_K, BLOCK_K):
        k_offs = k0 + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
        k_mask = k_offs < TOTAL_K
        ic = k_offs // KHW
        rem = k_offs % KHW
        kh = rem // KW
        kw = rem % KW
        ih = oh[None, :] * stride - pad + kh[:, None]
        iw = ow[None, :] * stride - pad + kw[:, None]
        valid = k_mask[:, None] & mask_pix[None, :] & (ih >= 0) & (ih < H_in) & (iw >= 0) & (iw < W_in)
        x_offset = (pid_b.to(tl.int64) * stride_xb
                    + ic[:, None].to(tl.int64) * stride_xc
                    + ih.to(tl.int64) * stride_xh
                    + iw.to(tl.int64) * stride_xw)
        x_tile = tl.load(x_ptr + x_offset, mask=valid, other=0.0)
        w_offset = (oc_offs[:, None].to(tl.int64) * stride_wo
                    + ic[None, :].to(tl.int64) * stride_wi
                    + kh[None, :] * stride_wh
                    + kw[None, :] * stride_ww)
        w_mask = mask_oc[:, None] & k_mask[None, :]
        w_tile = tl.load(w_ptr + w_offset, mask=w_mask, other=0.0)
        acc += tl.dot(w_tile, x_tile)
    bias = tl.load(b_ptr + oc_offs, mask=mask_oc, other=0.0)
    acc += bias[:, None]

                  + oc_offs.to(tl.int64)[:, None] * stride_oc
                  + oh.to(tl.int64)[None, :] * stride_oh
                  + ow.to(tl.int64)[None, :] * stride_ow)
    out_mask = mask_oc[:, None] & mask_pix[None, :]
    tl.store(out_ptr + out_offset, acc, mask=out_mask)

    b = torch.randn(C_out, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
    out = torch.empty(B, C_out, H_out, W_out, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
    BLOCK_SIZE = 128

    custom_kernel[grid](
        x, w, b, out,
        B, C_in, H_in, W_in, C_out, H_out, W_out,
        stride, pad,
